DIGITAL.description: The pin can be used for one or more of these functions: Step, dir, enable, encoder index, hall effect encoder, SPI encoder nCS (this one is exclusive).

DIGITAL_PULL_UP.description: Same as DIGITAL but with the internal pull-up resistor enabled.

DIGITAL_PULL_DOWN.description: Same as DIGITAL but with the internal pull-down resistor enabled.

ANALOG_IN.description: The pin can be used for one or more of these functions: Sin/cos encoders, analog input, get_adc_voltage().

UART_B.description: This mode is not supported on ODrive v3.x.

UART_C.description: This mode is not supported on ODrive v3.x.

SPI_A.description: Note that the SPI pins on ODrive v3.x are hardwired so they cannot be configured through software. Consequently, even though SPI_A is exposed, this mode is of no use on ODrive v3.x.

ENC0.description: The pin is used by quadrature encoder 0.

ENC1.description: The pin is used by quadrature encoder 1.

ENC2.description: This mode is not supported on ODrive v3.x.

MECH_BRAKE.description: This is to support external mechanical brakes.

STATUS.description: The pin is used for status output (see axis.config.error_gpio_pin)

BRAKE_RES.description: The pin is used to control a brake resistor board.

AUTO.description: Let the ODrive decide how to use the pin. If multiple components try to use the same pin only one of them will be initialized and the other one will have a status of kBadConfig.

FIBRE.description: Deprecated. For machine-to-machine communication it is recommended to use CAN bus instead.

ASCII.description: Human readable protocol designed for easy implementation for cases where the use of libfibre is not desired or feasible. Refer to this page ` for details.

STDOUT.description: Output of printf(). Only intended for developers who modify ODrive firmware.

IN_RANGE.description: Field strength is within the normal operating range.

OFF_SCALE_LOW.description: Field strength is below the minimum threshold. The angle measurement may be unreliable.

OFF_SCALE_HIGH.description: Field strength exceeds the maximum threshold. Resolution may be slightly degraded.

UNKNOWN.description: Unable to communicate with the encoder or inconsistent result.

NONE.description: The ODrive will not proactively go to IDLE if the field strength goes out of range. This mode should be used with caution as it can lead to uncontrolled spinout.

LOW.description: Go to IDLE when the field strength drops below the minimum requirement (20mT). Will cause a status of ComponentStatus.EncoderFieldTooLow when triggered.

HIGH.description: Go to IDLE when the field strength exceeds the maximum recommended (120mT). Will cause a status of ComponentStatus.EncoderFieldTooHigh when triggered.

BOTH.description: Go to IDLE under both high and low field conditions.

ENCODER_FIELD_TOO_LOW.description: Magnetic field strength was insufficient for a reliable angle measurement. See field_check_mode and the magnetic encoders article.

ENCODER_FIELD_TOO_HIGH.description: Magnetic field strength was excessive for a reliable angle measurement. See field_check_mode and the magnetic encoders article.

INITIALIZING.description: The ODrive is initializing or reconfiguring.

SYSTEM_LEVEL.description: Unexpected system error such as memory corruption, stack overflow, frozen thread, assert fail etc. This error is indicates firmware bug.

TIMING_ERROR.description: An internal hard timing requirement was violated. This usually means that the device is computationally overloaded, either due to a specific user configuration or due to a firmware bug. This error should not occur during normal operation and can be considered similar to SYSTEM_ERROR.

MISSING_ESTIMATE.description: The position estimate, velocity estimate or phase estimate was needed but invalid. This can mean:

BAD_CONFIG.description: The ODrive configuration is invalid or incomplete. If you configured the ODrive through the GUI’s Configuration tab (without manual overrides in the GUI Inspector), this could indicate a bug in the GUI’s configuration logic.

DRV_FAULT.description: The gate driver chip reported an error.

MISSING_INPUT.description: No value was provided for input_pos, input_vel or input_torque.

DC_BUS_OVER_VOLTAGE.description: The DC voltage exceeded the limit configured in config.dc_bus_overvoltage_trip_level.

DC_BUS_UNDER_VOLTAGE.description: The DC voltage fell below the limit configured in config.dc_bus_undervoltage_trip_level.

DC_BUS_OVER_CURRENT.description: Too much DC current was pulled, either at the motor level or at the board level (these two are identical for boards that don’t support a brake resistor).

DC_BUS_OVER_REGEN_CURRENT.description: Too much DC current was regenerated, either at the motor level or at the board level (these two are identical for boards that don’t support a brake resistor).

CURRENT_LIMIT_VIOLATION.description: The motor current exceeded <axis>.config.motor.current_hard_max. or config.inverterN.current_hard_max.

MOTOR_OVER_TEMP.description: The motor thermistor measured a temperature above motor.motor_thermistor.config.temp_limit_upper

INVERTER_OVER_TEMP.description: The inverter thermistor measured a temperature above motor.fet_thermistor.config.temp_limit_upper

VELOCITY_LIMIT_VIOLATION.description: The estimated velocity exceeds vel_limit_tolerance * vel_limit

REQUESTED_CURRENT_TOO_HIGH.description: The requested calibration current exceeded the effective current limit (effective_current_lim)

ESTOP_REQUESTED.description: An estop was requested from an external source. This can mean:

SPINOUT_DETECTED.description: A discrepancy between electrical power and mechanical power has been detected, indicating a spinout situation. See Spinout Detection for details.

BRAKE_RESISTOR_DISARMED.description: Another component (axis or brake resistor) on the ODrive failed. Most commonly this error indicates that the brake resistor was disarmed (e.g. during an undervoltage condition) and can be rectified by fixing the root cause (e.g. undervoltage condition) and then clearing errors.

THERMISTOR_DISCONNECTED.description: The motor thermistor is enabled but disconnected. This is determined by the analog voltage lying too close to 0V or 3.3V.

CALIBRATION_ERROR.description: A calibration procedure failed. See procedure_result for details.

SUCCESS.description: The procedure finished without any faults.

BUSY.description: The procedure has not yet finished.

CANCELLED.description: The last procedure was cancelled by the user.

DISARMED.description: A fault was encountered and the axis has been disarmed. See disarm_reason for more info.

NO_RESPONSE.description: The procedure component did not respond as expected

POLE_PAIR_CPR_MISMATCH.description: The values of config.motor.pole_pairs and/or inc_encoder0.config.cpr do not corroborate the measured rotations. Please verify these settings match the hardware.

PHASE_RESISTANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: The measured motor phase resistance is outside of the plausible range or bad calibration parameters were used.

PHASE_INDUCTANCE_OUT_OF_RANGE.description: The measured motor phase inductance is outside of the plausible range or bad calibration parameters were used.

UNBALANCED_PHASES.description: The motor phase resistances are not balanced. Please check your connections.

INVALID_MOTOR_TYPE.description: The value of ...config.motor.motor_type is not defined in the MotorType enum.

ILLEGAL_HALL_STATE.description: During hall encoder calibration the ODrive detected too many bad hall states. Make sure your encoder is wired correctly and produces a clean signal.

HOMING_WITHOUT_ENDSTOP.description: Homing was requested without enabling the endstop. Make sure <axis>.min_endstop.config.enabled <ODrive.Endstop.Config>enabled is True.

INVALID_STATE.description: The requested state must be a valid AxisState.

NOT_CALIBRATED.description: The requested state could not be entered because the axis is not calibrated.

REQUESTED_CURRENT_TOO_HIGH.description: The requested calibration or lockin spin current exceeded the configured current limit.

SPEED_10M.description: A/B inputs support a frequency of up to 2.5MHz (10M counts/s)

SPEED_20M.description: A/B inputs support a frequency of up to 5MHz (20M counts/s)

QUADRATIC.description: Can be used for any thermistor that can be expressed as a quadratic function.

IDLE.description: Disable motor PWM and do nothing.

FULL_CALIBRATION_SEQUENCE.description: Run all essential calibration procedures for the current ODrive configuration

MOTOR_CALIBRATION.description: Measure phase resistance and phase inductance of the motor.

ENCODER_INDEX_SEARCH.description: Turn the motor in one direction until the encoder index is traversed.

ENCODER_OFFSET_CALIBRATION.description: Turn the motor in one direction for a few seconds and then back to measure the offset between the encoder position and the electrical phase.

ENCODER_HALL_POLARITY_CALIBRATION.description: Rotate the motor in lockin and calibrate hall polarity

ENCODER_HALL_PHASE_CALIBRATION.description: Rotate the motor for 30s to calibrate hall sensor edge offsets

VOLTAGE_CONTROL.description: Note: This mode is not used internally. For voltage-only FOC, use MotorType.PMSM_VOLTAGE_CONTROL

TORQUE_CONTROL.description: Uses only the inner torque control loop. Use input_torque to command desired torque. Note the setting config.motor.torque_constant. Note the setting enable_torque_mode_vel_limit.

VELOCITY_CONTROL.description: Uses both the inner torque control loop and the velocity control loop. Use input_vel to command desired velocity, and input_torque.

POSITION_CONTROL.description: Uses the inner torque loop, the velocity control loop, and the outer position control loop. Use input_pos to command desired position, input_vel to command velocity feed-forward, and input_torque for torque feed-forward.

INACTIVE.description: Disable inputs. Setpoints retain their last value.

PASSTHROUGH.description: Pass input_xxx through to xxx_setpoint directly.

VEL_RAMP.description: Ramps a velocity command from the current value to the target value.

POS_FILTER.description: Implements a 2nd order position tracking filter.

TRAP_TRAJ.description: Implementes an online trapezoidal trajectory planner.

TORQUE_RAMP.description: Ramp a torque command from the current value to the target value.

get_adc_voltage.name: get_adc_voltage

enter_dfu_mode2.name: enter_dfu_mode2
enter_dfu_mode2.description: Enters the ODrive Device Firmware Update mode (DFU-over-CAN).

get_dma_status.name: get_dma_status

clear_errors.name: clear_errors
clear_errors.description: Clears disarm_reason and procedure_result and re-arms the brake resistor if applicable

axis{n}.mechanical_brake.engage.name: engage

axis{n}.mechanical_brake.release.name: release

axis{n}.controller.move_incremental.name: move_incremental

vbus_voltage.name: vbus_voltage
vbus_voltage.description: Voltage on the DC bus as measured by the ODrive.

ibus.name: ibus
ibus.description: Current on the DC bus as calculated by the ODrive.

ibus_report_filter_k.name: ibus_report_filter_k
ibus_report_filter_k.description: Filter gain for the reported ibus. Set to a value below 1.0 to get a smoother line when plotting ibus. Set to 1.0 to disable. This filter is only applied to the reported value and not for internal calculations.

serial_number.name: serial_number
serial_number.description: Integer representation of the serial number of the device

n_evt_sampling.name: n_evt_sampling
n_evt_sampling.description: Number of input sampling events since startup (modulo 2^32)

n_evt_control_loop.name: n_evt_control_loop
n_evt_control_loop.description: Number of control loop iterations since startup (modulo 2^32). Wraps around after 6.2 days (assuming 8kHz control loop frequency).

task_timers_armed.name: task_timers_armed
task_timers_armed.description: Set by a profiling application to trigger sampling of a single control iteration. Cleared by the device as soon as the sampling is complete.

misconfigured.name: misconfigured
misconfigured.description: If this property is true, something is bad in the configuration. The ODrive can still be used in this state but the user should investigate which setting is problematic. This variable does not cover all misconfigurations.

identify.name: identify
identify.description: Flashes the status LED when enabled.

reboot_required.name: reboot_required
reboot_required.description: Can be used by support software to indicate that a reboot is required.

config.uart_a_baudrate.name: uart_a_baudrate
config.uart_a_baudrate.description: Defines the baudrate used on the UART interface.

config.usb_cdc_protocol.name: usb_cdc_protocol
config.usb_cdc_protocol.description: The protocol that’s being run on the device’s virtual COM port on USB. Note that the ODrive has two independent interfaces on USB: One is the virtual COM port (affected by this option) and the other one is a vendor specific interface which always runs Fibre. So changing this option does not affect the working of odrivetool.

config.max_regen_current.name: max_regen_current
config.max_regen_current.description: The bus current allowed to flow back to the power supply before the brake resistor module will start shunting current.

config.dc_bus_undervoltage_trip_level.name: dc_bus_undervoltage_trip_level
config.dc_bus_undervoltage_trip_level.description: Minimum voltage below which the motor stops operating.

config.dc_bus_overvoltage_trip_level.name: dc_bus_overvoltage_trip_level
config.dc_bus_overvoltage_trip_level.description: Maximum DC bus voltage above which the motor stops operating.

config.dc_max_positive_current.name: dc_max_positive_current
config.dc_max_positive_current.description: Max current the power supply can source.

config.dc_max_negative_current.name: dc_max_negative_current
config.dc_max_negative_current.description: Max current the power supply can sink.

brake_resistor0.additional_duty.name: additional_duty
brake_resistor0.additional_duty.description: Additional duty cycle to add, on top of the value that is based on motor current and DC voltage.

brake_resistor0.current.name: current
brake_resistor0.current.description: Calculated current dumped into the brake resistor.

brake_resistor0.chopper_temp.name: chopper_temp
brake_resistor0.chopper_temp.description: Estimate of the brake resistor chopper temperature.

brake_resistor0.was_saturated.name: was_saturated
brake_resistor0.was_saturated.description: Indicates if the brake resistor reached saturation. This flag is latching and needs to be reset by the client before it can indicate another saturation event.

config.brake_resistor0.enable.name: enable
config.brake_resistor0.enable.description: Enable/disable the use of a brake resistor.

config.brake_resistor0.resistance.name: resistance
config.brake_resistor0.resistance.description: Value of the brake resistor connected to the ODrive.

config.brake_resistor0.enable_dc_bus_vol.name: enable_dc_bus_voltage_feedback
config.brake_resistor0.enable_dc_bus_vol.description: Enables the DC bus voltage feedback brake resistor feature.

config.inverter0.current_soft_max.name: current_soft_max
config.inverter0.current_soft_max.description: Maximum commanded current allowed for this inverter. See also motor.current_soft_max.

config.inverter0.current_hard_max.name: current_hard_max
config.inverter0.current_hard_max.description: Maximum measured current allowed for this inverter. Any measurement above current_hard_max will throw a CURRENT_LIMIT_VIOLATION error. See also motor.current_hard_max.

config.inverter0.derating_start.name: derating_start
config.inverter0.derating_start.description: Voltage at which the inverter starts derating the current limit

config.inverter0.current_soft_max_derate.name: current_soft_max_derated
config.inverter0.current_soft_max_derate.description: Maximum commanded current allowed for this inverter at its maximum DC voltage

config.inverter0.temp_limit_lower.name: temp_limit_lower
config.inverter0.temp_limit_lower.description: The lower limit when the controller starts limiting current. Writes to this parameter are ignored unless in developer mode.

config.inverter0.temp_limit_upper.name: temp_limit_upper
config.inverter0.temp_limit_upper.description: The upper limit when current limit reaches 0 Amps and an over temperature error is triggered. Writes to this parameter are ignored unless in developer mode.

config.inverter0.shunt_conductance.name: shunt_conductance
config.inverter0.shunt_conductance.description: Set this to 1.0 / R_shunt if you have modified the shunt resistors. Writes to this parameter are ignored unless in developer mode.

config.inverter0.drv_config.name: drv_config
config.inverter0.drv_config.description: Do not modify unless you know what you’re doing. Writes to this parameter are ignored unless in developer mode.

can.n_restarts.name: n_restarts
can.n_restarts.description: Counter for how many times the CAN interface was restarted

can.effective_baudrate.name: effective_baudrate
can.effective_baudrate.description: Shows the effective baudrate in use after autobaud detection

can.config.baud_rate.name: baud_rate
can.config.baud_rate.description: The baudrate of the CAN bus. Only compatible baudrates are accepted.

can.config.data_baud_rate.name: data_baud_rate
can.config.data_baud_rate.description: The baudrate of the data phase of CAN-FD messages.

can.config.tx_brs.name: tx_brs
can.config.tx_brs.description: If true, the ODrive sends all CAN messages as CAN-FD frames with the BRS (Bit Rate Switch) flag set and using data_baud_rate in the data phase. If false, CAN messages are sent as CAN Classic frames.

can.config.protocol.name: protocol
can.config.protocol.description: Specifies which protocol is running on the CAN interface. If no protocol is enabled, the CAN interface is disabled.

axis{n}.config.can.node_id.name: node_id
axis{n}.config.can.node_id.description: CAN node ID of the ODrive

axis{n}.config.can.input_vel_scale.name: input_vel_scale
axis{n}.config.can.input_vel_scale.description: Scale of the Vel_FF field in Set_Input_Pos.

axis{n}.config.can.input_torque_scale.name: input_torque_scale
axis{n}.config.can.input_torque_scale.description: Scale of the Torque_FF field in Set_Input_Pos.

axis{n}.active_errors.name: active_errors
axis{n}.active_errors.description: Indicates the current error condition(s) of the axis. Each error flag clears automatically when the error condition goes away. If an attempt is made to activate the axis while an error is present, the axis immediately disarms and disarm_reason is updated accordingly.

axis{n}.disarm_reason.name: disarm_reason
axis{n}.disarm_reason.description: This value is updated every time the axis disarms and indicates the reason why the axis was disarmed. It can be cleared using clear_errors(). This variable is used for reporting only. It affects the status LED and the ERROR pin output but it does not prevent the axis from getting re-armed upon user request.

axis{n}.detailed_disarm_reason.name: detailed_disarm_reason
axis{n}.detailed_disarm_reason.description: Adds more detail to disarm_reason. Not yet implemented for all error types.

axis{n}.steps.name: steps
axis{n}.steps.description: The current commanded position, in steps, while in step_dir mode

axis{n}.current_state.name: current_state
axis{n}.current_state.description: The current state of the axis

axis{n}.is_homed.name: is_homed
axis{n}.is_homed.description: Whether or not the axis has been successfully homed.

axis{n}.total_charge_used.name: total_charge_used
axis{n}.total_charge_used.description: Total number of coulombs drawn from the bus, since boot. Can be negative, if total regenerated current is greater than total drawn current. Does not include ODrive quiescent draw or power dissipated through brake resistor. Not guaranteed to be accurate.

axis{n}.total_power_used.name: total_power_used
axis{n}.total_power_used.description: Total number of joules drawn from the bus, since boot. Can be negative, if total regenerated power is greater than total drawn power. Does not include ODrive quiescent draw or power dissipated through brake resistor. Not guaranteed to be accurate.

axis{n}.config.anticogging.max_torque.name: max_torque
axis{n}.config.anticogging.max_torque.description: Maximum torque action that anticogging is allowed to exert.

axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_coarse_.name: calib_coarse_tuning_duration
axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_coarse_.description: Duration of the coarse tuning (ramp down) phase.

axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_fine_tu.name: calib_fine_tuning_duration
axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_fine_tu.description: Duration of the fine tuning phase.

axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_coarse_.name: calib_coarse_integrator_gain
axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_coarse_.description: Integrator gain at the start of anticogging calibration.

axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_bidirec.name: calib_bidirectional
axis{n}.config.anticogging.calib_bidirec.description: Whether to run the calibration in both directions

axis{n}.config.startup_max_wait_for_read.name: startup_max_wait_for_ready
axis{n}.config.startup_max_wait_for_read.description: Maximum time to wait for active_errors_ to go clear before trying to start any of the startup actions. Default 3 seconds.

axis{n}.config.startup_motor_calibration.name: startup_motor_calibration
axis{n}.config.startup_motor_calibration.description: Run motor calibration at startup, skip otherwise

axis{n}.config.startup_closed_loop_contr.name: startup_closed_loop_control
axis{n}.config.startup_closed_loop_contr.description: Enable closed loop control after calibration/startup

axis{n}.config.init_torque.name: init_torque
axis{n}.config.init_torque.description: Initial torque setpoint (or feed-forward) that will be applied when axis is put into closed loop control

axis{n}.config.init_vel.name: init_vel
axis{n}.config.init_vel.description: Initial velocity setpoint (or feed-forward) that will be applied when axis is put into closed loop control. Does not apply in sensorless mode unless use_init_vel_for_sensorless is True.

axis{n}.config.init_pos.name: init_pos
axis{n}.config.init_pos.description: Initial position setpoint that will be applied when axis is put into closed loop control. NaN to use current position estimate as initialization value of position setpoint.

axis{n}.config.use_init_vel_for_sensorle.name: use_init_vel_for_sensorless
axis{n}.config.use_init_vel_for_sensorle.description: Use init_vel as the initial target velocity in sensorless mode after open-loop ramp.

axis{n}.config.enable_step_dir.name: enable_step_dir
axis{n}.config.enable_step_dir.description: Enable step/dir input after calibration. Make sure to set the corresponding GPIO’s mode to GpioMode.DIGITAL.

axis{n}.config.step_dir_always_on.name: step_dir_always_on
axis{n}.config.step_dir_always_on.description: Keep step/dir enabled while the motor is disabled. This is ignored if enable_step_dir is false. This setting only takes effect on a state transition into idle or out of closed loop control.

axis{n}.config.calib_scan_distance.name: calib_scan_distance
axis{n}.config.calib_scan_distance.description: Sets the distance the motor will move during AxisState.ENCODER_OFFSET_CALIBRATION

axis{n}.config.enable_watchdog.name: enable_watchdog
axis{n}.config.enable_watchdog.description: Enables the watchdog for this axis.

axis{n}.config.I_bus_hard_min.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.I_bus_hard_min.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.I_bus_hard_max.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.I_bus_hard_max.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.I_bus_soft_min.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.I_bus_soft_min.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.I_bus_soft_max.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.I_bus_soft_max.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.P_bus_soft_min.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.P_bus_soft_min.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.P_bus_soft_max.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.P_bus_soft_max.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.torque_soft_min.name: torque_soft_min
axis{n}.config.torque_soft_min.description: Minimum negative commanded torque allowed in the torque loop. This is usually a negative number.

axis{n}.config.torque_soft_max.name: torque_soft_max
axis{n}.config.torque_soft_max.description: Maximum positive commanded torque allowed in the torque loop. If you set this, in all likelihood you also want to set torque_soft_min.

axis{n}.config.off_axis_k.name: off_axis_k
axis{n}.config.off_axis_k.description: Skew parameter for off-axis mounting of magnetic encoders.

axis{n}.config.off_axis_k_commutation.name: off_axis_k_commutation
axis{n}.config.off_axis_k_commutation.description: Skew parameter for off-axis mounting of magnetic encoders.

axis{n}.config.calibration_lockin.vel.description: Overridden by calib_scan_vel during encoder offset calibration.

axis{n}.observed_encoder_scale_factor.name: observed_encoder_scale_factor
axis{n}.observed_encoder_scale_factor.description: Ratio between the encoder-to-motor scale observed during AxisState.ENCODER_OFFSET_CALIBRATION and the configured encoder-to-motor scale.

axis{n}.config.startup_encoder_index_sea.name: startup_encoder_index_search
axis{n}.config.startup_encoder_index_sea.description: Run encoder index search after startup, skip otherwise this only has an effect if commutation_mapper.config.use_index_gpio is also true

axis{n}.config.startup_encoder_offset_ca.name: startup_encoder_offset_calibration
axis{n}.config.startup_encoder_offset_ca.description: Run encoder offset calibration after startup, skip otherwise

axis{n}.config.load_encoder.name: load_encoder
axis{n}.config.load_encoder.description: Specifies which encoder will be used as the load encoder

axis{n}.config.commutation_encoder.name: commutation_encoder
axis{n}.config.commutation_encoder.description: Specifies which encoder will be used as the commutation encoder

axis{n}.config.encoder_bandwidth.name: encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.encoder_bandwidth.description: Bandwidth of the axis (primary) encoder state estimator

axis{n}.config.commutation_encoder_bandw.name: commutation_encoder_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.commutation_encoder_bandw.description: Bandwidth of the commutation encoder state estimator

onboard_encoder0.config.field_check_mode.name: field_check_mode
onboard_encoder0.config.field_check_mode.description: Selects which field strength conditions the magnetic encoder monitors for.

axis{n}.controller.config.use_load_encod.name: use_load_encoder_for_commutation_vel
axis{n}.controller.config.use_load_encod.description: When using two separate encoders for position control and commutation, this selects which of the two encoders is used for commutation (i.e. for estimating the phase velocity).

axis{n}.motor.torque_estimate.name: torque_estimate
axis{n}.motor.torque_estimate.description: Motor torque from measured current and config.motor.torque_constant. This value is filtered using <axis>.config.motor.power_torque_report_filter_bandwidth.

axis{n}.motor.loss_power.name: loss_power
axis{n}.motor.loss_power.description: Estimated power loss in the inverter and motor

axis{n}.motor.effective_current_lim.name: effective_current_lim
axis{n}.motor.effective_current_lim.description: Effective dynamic current limit based on motor and inverter limitations

axis{n}.motor.input_id.name: input_id
axis{n}.motor.input_id.description: Feedforward term for d-axis current. If ACIM autoflux is enabled, this parameter has no effect.

axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.max_.name: max_measurable_current
axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.max_.description: Indicates the maximum current that can be measured by the current sensors in the current hardware configuration. This value depends on <axis>.config.motor.current_hard_max and config.inverterN.current_hard_max.

axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.powe.name: power
axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.powe.description: DEPRECATED: Use <axis>.motor.electrical_power. The electrical power being delivered to the motor.

axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.n_ev.name: n_evt_current_measurement
axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.n_ev.description: Number of current measurement events since startup (modulo 2^32)

axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.n_ev.name: n_evt_pwm_update
axis{n}.motor.alpha_beta_controller.n_ev.description: Number of PWM update events since startup (modulo 2^32)

axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.rotor_flux.name: rotor_flux
axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.rotor_flux.description: estimated magnitude of the rotor flux

axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.slip_vel.name: slip_vel
axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.slip_vel.description: estimated slip between physical and electrical angular velocity}

axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.phase_offse.name: phase_offset
axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.phase_offse.description: estimate offset between physical and electrical angular position}

axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.stator_phas.name: stator_phase_vel
axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.stator_phas.description: calculated setpoint for the electrical velocity}

axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.stator_phas.name: stator_phase
axis{n}.motor.acim_estimator.stator_phas.description: calculated setpoint for the electrical phase}

axis{n}.config.motor.pole_pairs.name: pole_pairs
axis{n}.config.motor.pole_pairs.description: Number of magnet pole pairs in the motor’s rotor.

axis{n}.config.motor.phase_resistance_va.name: phase_resistance_valid
axis{n}.config.motor.phase_resistance_va.description: Indicates whether phase_resistance is valid. This flag is automatically set to true after successful motor calibration. It can also be set manually if phase_resistance is set manually. The motor will not spin unless this is true.

axis{n}.config.motor.phase_inductance_va.name: phase_inductance_valid
axis{n}.config.motor.phase_inductance_va.description: Indicates whether phase_inductance is valid. This flag is automatically set to true after successful motor calibration. It can also be set manually if phase_inductance is set manually. Depending on the configuration, the motor will not spin unless this is true (see phase_inductance for details).

axis{n}.config.motor.direction.name: direction
axis{n}.config.motor.direction.description: Direction of the motor (+1 or -1) with respect to the axis position space. This affects the spin direction of calibration procedures.

axis{n}.config.motor.current_control_ban.name: current_control_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.motor.current_control_ban.description: Sets the PI gains of the Q and D axis FOC control according to phase_resistance and phase_inductance to create a critically-damped controller with a -3dB bandwidth at this frequency.

axis{n}.config.motor.wL_FF_enable.name: wL_FF_enable
axis{n}.config.motor.wL_FF_enable.description: Enables automatic feedforward of the R and omega*L term in the current controller.

axis{n}.config.motor.bEMF_FF_enable.name: bEMF_FF_enable
axis{n}.config.motor.bEMF_FF_enable.description: Enables automatic feedforward of the bEMF term in the current controller.

axis{n}.config.motor.dI_dt_FF_enable.name: dI_dt_FF_enable
axis{n}.config.motor.dI_dt_FF_enable.description: Enables automatic feedforward of the dI/dt term in the current controller.

axis{n}.config.motor.ff_pm_flux_linkage.name: ff_pm_flux_linkage
axis{n}.config.motor.ff_pm_flux_linkage.description: Flux linkage of the motor, used by the motor model.

axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_d.name: motor_model_l_d
axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_d.description: d-axis phase inductance of the motor, used by the motor model

axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_q.name: motor_model_l_q
axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_q.description: q-axis phase inductance of the motor, used by the motor model

axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_dq_va.name: motor_model_l_dq_valid
axis{n}.config.motor.motor_model_l_dq_va.description: If true, the motor model uses motor_model_l_d and motor_model_l_q for feedforward terms and field weakening. If false, phase_inductance is used instead.

axis{n}.config.motor.calibration_current.name: calibration_current
axis{n}.config.motor.calibration_current.description: The current used to measure resistance during AxisState.MOTOR_CALIBRATION.

axis{n}.config.motor.resistance_calib_ma.name: resistance_calib_max_voltage
axis{n}.config.motor.resistance_calib_ma.description: The maximum voltage allowed during AxisState.MOTOR_CALIBRATION.

axis{n}.config.motor.current_soft_max.name: current_soft_max
axis{n}.config.motor.current_soft_max.description: Maximum commanded current allowed for this motor. There is a separate limit current_soft_max that pertains to the ODrive’s power stage.

axis{n}.config.motor.current_hard_max.name: current_hard_max
axis{n}.config.motor.current_hard_max.description: Maximum measured current allowed. Any measurement above current_hard_max will throw a CURRENT_LIMIT_VIOLATION error. Changing this variable can lead to reconfiguration of low level hardware at the next opportunity (when the axis is in IDLE). This will incur a 0.7s delay until the axis can be activated again. There is a separate limit current_hard_max that pertains to the ODrive’s power stage.

axis{n}.config.motor.current_slew_rate_l.name: current_slew_rate_limit
axis{n}.config.motor.current_slew_rate_l.description: Maximum slew rate for the current setpoint.

axis{n}.config.motor.acim_nominal_slip_v.name: acim_nominal_slip_vel
axis{n}.config.motor.acim_nominal_slip_v.description: 1/(2*pi*rotor_tau), where rotor_tau is time constant of the rotor (L_r/R_r)

axis{n}.config.motor.sensorless_pm_flux_.name: sensorless_pm_flux_linkage
axis{n}.config.motor.sensorless_pm_flux_.description: Flux linkage of the motor, used by the sensorless estimator.

axis{n}.config.motor.power_torque_report.name: power_torque_report_filter_bandwidth
axis{n}.config.motor.power_torque_report.description: Filter bandwidth for reported torque and power estimates

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.gp.name: gpio_pin
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.gp.description: GPIO on which the thermistor is connected.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.r_.name: r_ref
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.r_.description: Resistance of the thermistor at the reference temperature. Usually denoted R_25 in the thermistor’s datasheet.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.t_.name: t_ref
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.t_.description: Reference temperature corresponding to r_ref, in °C. Usually this is equal to 25°C and denoted T_25 in the thermistor’s datasheet.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.be.name: beta
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.be.description: Beta (or B) value of the thermistor. Can be found in the thermistor’s datasheet. Only used when mode is ThermistorMode.NTC.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.te.name: temp_limit_lower
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.te.description: The lower limit when the controller starts limiting current.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.te.name: temp_limit_upper
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.te.description: The upper limit when current limit reaches 0 Amps and an over temperature error is triggered.

axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.ig.name: ignore_disconnected
axis{n}.motor.motor_thermistor.config.ig.description: Ignore default thermistor disconnection detection thresholds.

axis{n}.controller.input_pos.name: input_pos
axis{n}.controller.input_pos.description: Set the desired position of the axis. Only valid in ControlMode.POSITION_CONTROL. In InputMode.TUNING, this acts as a DC offset for the position sine wave.

axis{n}.controller.input_vel.name: input_vel
axis{n}.controller.input_vel.description: In ControlMode.VELOCITY_CONTROL, sets the desired velocity of the axis. In ControlMode.POSITION_CONTROL, sets the feed-forward velocity of the velocity controller In InputMode.TUNING, this acts as a DC offset for the velocity sine wave.

axis{n}.controller.input_torque.name: input_torque
axis{n}.controller.input_torque.description: In ControlMode.TORQUE_CONTROL, sets the desired output torque of the axis. In ControlMode.VELOCITY_CONTROL and ControlMode.POSITION_CONTROL, sets the feed-forward torque of the torque controller in InputMode.VEL_RAMP, InputMode.POS_FILTER, InputMode.TRAP_TRAJ, and InputMode.TUNING

axis{n}.controller.pos_setpoint.name: pos_setpoint
axis{n}.controller.pos_setpoint.description: The position reference actually being used by the position controller. This is the same as input_pos in InputMode.PASSTHROUGH, but may vary according to InputMode.

axis{n}.controller.vel_setpoint.name: vel_setpoint
axis{n}.controller.vel_setpoint.description: The velocity reference actually being used by the velocity controller. This is the same as input_vel in InputMode.PASSTHROUGH, but may vary according to InputMode.

axis{n}.controller.torque_setpoint.name: torque_setpoint
axis{n}.controller.torque_setpoint.description: The torque reference actually being used by the torque controller. This is the same as input_torque in InputMode.PASSTHROUGH, but may vary according to InputMode.

axis{n}.controller.effective_torque_setp.name: effective_torque_setpoint
axis{n}.controller.effective_torque_setp.description: The torque output generated by the controller and fed to the motor model.

axis{n}.controller.trajectory_done.name: trajectory_done
axis{n}.controller.trajectory_done.description: Indicates the last commanded Trapezoidal Trajectory movement is complete.

axis{n}.controller.vel_integrator_torque.name: vel_integrator_torque
axis{n}.controller.vel_integrator_torque.description: The accumulated value of the velocity loop integrator

axis{n}.controller.autotuning_phase.name: autotuning_phase
axis{n}.controller.autotuning_phase.description: The current phase angle of the InputMode.TUNING sine wave generator

axis{n}.controller.config.enable_torque_.name: enable_torque_mode_vel_limit
axis{n}.controller.config.enable_torque_.description: Enable velocity limit in torque control mode (requires a valid velocity estimator).

axis{n}.controller.config.enable_gain_sc.name: enable_gain_scheduling
axis{n}.controller.config.enable_gain_sc.description: Enable the experimental “gain scheduling” module, which reduces the pos_gain, vel_gain, and vel_integrator_gain according to the position (in position control mode) or velocity (in velocity control mode). Also known as “anti-hunt”

axis{n}.controller.config.gain_schedulin.name: gain_scheduling_width
axis{n}.controller.config.gain_schedulin.description: Distance over which the gain scheduling operates.

axis{n}.controller.config.gain_schedulin.name: gain_scheduling_min_ratio
axis{n}.controller.config.gain_schedulin.description: Minimum gain ratio to apply when the position or velocity (dependent on control mode) is exactly at the setpoint

axis{n}.controller.config.enable_overspe.name: enable_overspeed_error
axis{n}.controller.config.enable_overspe.description: Enables the velocity controller’s overspeed error

axis{n}.controller.config.vel_integrator.name: vel_integrator_limit
axis{n}.controller.config.vel_integrator.description: Limit the integrator output (independent of proportional gain output). Set to infinity to disable.

axis{n}.controller.config.vel_integrator.name: vel_integrator_decay_gain
axis{n}.controller.config.vel_integrator.description: Whenever the velocity controller is saturated, vel_integrator_torque will decay by this ratio per control tick. Must be a value <= 1.0

axis{n}.controller.config.vel_limit_tole.name: vel_limit_tolerance
axis{n}.controller.config.vel_limit_tole.description: Ratio to vel_limit. Infinity to disable. Must be larger than 1.

axis{n}.controller.config.circular_setpo.name: circular_setpoint_range
axis{n}.controller.config.circular_setpo.description: circular range in [turns] for position setpoints when circular_setpoints is True

axis{n}.controller.config.absolute_setpo.name: absolute_setpoints
axis{n}.controller.config.absolute_setpo.description: False: Position setpoints are relative to the startup position.

axis{n}.controller.config.use_commutatio.name: use_commutation_vel
axis{n}.controller.config.use_commutatio.description: When using two separate encoders for position control and commutation, this selects which of the two encoders is used for velocity control. If false, the position encoder is used, else the commutation encoder is used. commutation_vel_scale must be set accordingly.

axis{n}.controller.config.commutation_ve.name: commutation_vel_scale
axis{n}.controller.config.commutation_ve.description: Defines the scale between load encoder and commutation encoder. Must be configured if use_commutation_vel or use_load_encoder_for_commutation_vel is true.

axis{n}.controller.config.steps_per_circ.name: steps_per_circular_range
axis{n}.controller.config.steps_per_circ.description: Number of steps within the circular setpoint range. Set this and the circular setpoint range to powers of 2 for the best results.

axis{n}.controller.config.homing_speed.name: homing_speed
axis{n}.controller.config.homing_speed.description: The speed at which the axis moves towards the min_endstop during AxisState.HOMING

axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_mechan.name: spinout_mechanical_power_bandwidth
axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_mechan.description: Bandwidth for mechanical power estimate. Used for spinout detection

axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_electr.name: spinout_electrical_power_bandwidth
axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_electr.description: Bandwidth for electrical power estimate. Used for spinout detection. Dot product of Vdq and Idq

axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_mechan.name: spinout_mechanical_power_threshold
axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_mechan.description: Mechanical power threshold for spinout detection. This should be a negative value

axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_electr.name: spinout_electrical_power_threshold
axis{n}.controller.config.spinout_electr.description: Electrical power threshold for spinout detection. This should be a positive value
